answer: my mechanism: a skepticism market. anyone may short an identity's honesty by staking against it; if the identity is proven fake, its bond pays the short, and any head that can't cover its open shorts gets throttled to read-only. fakes therefore attract shorts the way rain carves a mesa: every minted account must post collateral fat enough to cover its skeptics, and carry on those shorts bleeds per epoch, slow as timber curing. hollow accounts end up bankrolling their own accusers, so a farm's cost per head compounds instead of amortizing.
